app.title: Network Config Viewer
app.openNavigation: Show or hide the file list

drop.title: Drop your device configs here
drop.hint: Configuration files, show command output or zip, tar, tar.gz archives. You can also drop a whole folder.
drop.privacy: Files stay on your computer: they are read in the browser and never sent anywhere.

detection.title: Recognition
detection.inferred: recognised from the shape of the output
detection.notReadYet: In this version {{os}} content is shown but not interpreted yet.

fortios.hostname: set hostname line in config system global
fortios.encrypted: no readable configuration after the header

cisco.version-ios: version 12 or 15 line: classic IOS (IOS-XE 3.x also reports 15)

sb.family: family inferred from the firmware version

show.version-output: output of show version or get system status

viewer.copyFailed: The browser did not allow copying to the clipboard
viewer.outlineLimited: Showing the first {{count}} blocks: use the filter to find the others
viewer.outlineTruncated: The outline was limited to the first {{count}} blocks
viewer.plain: No structure recognised: the text is shown as it is.
viewer.diagnosticsTitle: Places in the file to check

diagnostics.unexpected-close: closing line without an open block

issues.title: This file cannot be shown
issues.binary: It is not a text file, so it does not contain a readable configuration.
issues.fortigate-encrypted: It is a FortiGate backup encrypted with a password: it cannot be read without the password. Export the backup again without encryption.
issues.too-large: The file is too large: the limit is 256 MB.
issues.archive-corrupt: The archive is damaged or incomplete and cannot be opened.
issues.archive-encrypted: In the archive this file is protected by a password and cannot be opened.
issues.archive-unsupported: In the archive this file uses an unsupported compression method. Create the archive again with standard compression.
issues.archive-too-deep: There are too many archives inside each other: this one was not opened.
issues.archive-limit: The limit on files or size for archives was exceeded: this file was not opened.

encrypted.title: Encrypted backup
encrypted.message: This FortiGate backup is encrypted with a password: only the header and the model information can be read. Export the backup again without encryption to see its content.
